answer_1.quote: To bridge the gap of the knowledge between the human and the machine, researchers have begun to introduce large-scale knowledge graphs for enhancing the dialogue generation

answer_2.quote: Objective Metrics: We evaluate the generated responses from four aspects: Knowledge Utilization (A1): E_match is the averaged number of the matched target entities per generation. . E_use further counts the source entities. E_recall is the ratio of recalled entities. Embeddingbased Relevance (A2a) : Following , we use the Emb_avg that considers the averaged word embedding, and the Emb_ex that considers each dimension's extreme value. Overlappingbased Relevance (A2b) : BLEU-2/3 . Diversity (A3): ... the ratio of distinct uni/bi-grams, i.e., Distinct-1/2, in all generated texts . Informativeness (A4): ... the wordlevel Entropy .

answer_4.quote: Following , we randomly sample 200 query messages from the test set, and then we conduct the pair-wise comparison. For each pair, we invite three well-educated volunteers to judge which response is better, in terms of the following two metrics: 1) Appropriateness, which mainly considers the fluency and the logical relevance. 2) Informativeness, which considers whether the model provides new information/knowledge or not.
answer_4.guideline: Volunteers judged responses based on appropriateness (fluency and logical relevance) and informativeness (provision of new information or knowledge).
